name: MEGA folders
description: Lists the files behind a public MEGA folder link or a folder of the signed-in account, with names, sizes and structure.

codes.mega_crawler.key_invalid: This MEGA folder link carries no usable key
codes.mega_crawler.not_a_folder: This is not a MEGA folder address
codes.mega_crawler.not_in_account: This folder is no longer in the MEGA account
codes.mega_crawler.quota_exceeded: MEGA's transfer quota for this folder is used up
codes.mega_crawler.rate_limited: MEGA is rate limiting requests from this address
codes.mega_crawler.session_expired: The MEGA account's session has run out; sign it in again
